Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
v_local_time date;

begin
 begin
 select forms_type, '0'
 into :display_forms_type , :echo_count
 from rpt_report_names
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and report_name = :rpt_parm.report_name;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null;
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
--
 if :report_status = 'C'
 then
 :dis_report_status := 'Completed';
 elsif :report_status = 'S'
 then
 :dis_report_status := 'Submitted';
 elsif :report_status = 'E'
 then

 else

 end if;
 
-- below code by Jairam Kulkarni to convert GMT to local time

 else
 :RPT_PARM.C_SUBMIT_DATE := :RPT_PARM.SUBMIT_DATE; -- Modified on 05/06/2012; IM:8569
 
 end if;
 -- end if;
 -- 
 
 
 BEGIN
 IF :RPT_PARM.REP_JOB_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 
 SELECT status_message INTO :RPT_PARM.S_STATUS
 FROM rw_server_job_queue
 WHERE job_id = :RPT_PARM.REP_JOB_ID
 AND UPPER(job_name) = UPPER(:RPT_PARM.REPORT_NAME);
 
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY_COMMIT_OLD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 filename VARCHAR2(50) := NULL;
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
begin
 enter;
 check_package_failure;
 if :action not in ('R','D','P','L')
 then
 message('Err: Invalid action entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 --
 if :rpt_parm.rowid is null
 then
 message ('Err: No report selected');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 --
 if :action != 'D'
 then
 if :report_status != 'C'
 then
 message('Err: Report not in completed status');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 --
 filename := '$REPOUTPUT/' || :report_name ||
 '_' || :parm_id || '_' || :rpt_parm.user_name ||'.r';
 --
 if :action = 'R'
 then
 command := get_review_command (filename ,
 :rpt_parm.display_forms_type );
 elsif :action = 'D'
 then
 command := get_delete_command (filename);
 elsif :action = 'P'
 then
 command := get_print_command (filename,
 :rpt_parm.display_forms_type,
 null ,
 :ctrl_block_1.user_printer_id );
 elsif :action = 'L'
 then
 command := get_locprint_command (filename,
 :rpt_parm.display_forms_type );
 end if;
 host_command (command );
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_DELETE_COMMAND
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
function get_delete_command ( filename in VARCHAR2 )
return VARCHAR2 is
begin
 return ( '/bin/rm -f ' ||' '|| filename );
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_LOCPRINT_COMMAND
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
function get_locprint_command ( filename in VARCHAR2 , form_type in VARCHAR2 )
return VARCHAR2 is
begin
 return ( 'locprint.sh'||' '|| filename||' '|| form_type);
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PRINT_COMMAND
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
function get_print_command ( filename in VARCHAR2 ,
 form_type in VARCHAR2,
 printer_id in VARCHAR2,
 user_printer_id in VARCHAR2 )
return VARCHAR2 is
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
begin
 select code_info || ' ' ||
 decode(printer_id,NULL,
 decode(user_printer_id,NULL,NULL,'-d'||user_printer_id),
 '-d'||printer_id) || ' ' ||
 filename
 into command
 from rpt_master_codes
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and code_type = 'FORM'
 and code = form_type;
 return ( command);
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_REVIEW_COMMAND
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
function get_review_command ( filename in VARCHAR2 , form_type in VARCHAR2 )
return VARCHAR2 is
begin
 return ( 'rmreview.sh '||' '|| filename ||' '|| form_type );
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: HOST_COMMAND
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure host_command ( command in VARCHAR2 ) is
 record_no number(4);
begin
 if :ACTION = 'D'
 then
 HOST(COMMAND,NO_SCREEN);
 else
 HOST(COMMAND);
 if form_failure
 then
 message('Err: The report action failed.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
--
 if :action = 'D'
 then
 record_no := :system.cursor_record;
 :submit_date := NULL ;
 :report_status := NULL;
 commit;
 execute_query;
 go_record(record_no);
 end if;
 :action := NULL ;
 GO_ITEM ('action');
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_ACTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure validate_action is
begin
 if :action is not null then
 message ('Err: Please [COMMIT] current action');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
end;

PROCEDURE print_extract_report(p_file IN VARCHAR2) IS -- V04 (p_file added)
 szExtrLoc VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
 in_file Text_IO.File_Type;
 filename VARCHAR2(200);
 p_session_id VARCHAR2(40);
 szBuffer VARCHAR2(200);
 szStatus VARCHAR2(500); 
BEGIN
 p_session_id := to_char(sysdate, 'mmddyyhh24miss');
 if :action != 'D' then
 if :report_status != 'C' then
 message('Err: Report not in completed status');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 --

 --get the util file directory name
 begin
 select code_desc
 into szExtrLoc
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'LOGDR'
 and code = 'EXTRT'
 and rownum = 1
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 1);
 exception
 when others then
 message(sqlerrm || ': Log directory is not mentioned');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 -- V04 - calling new function in lab_common.
 LAB_COMMON.POP_EXTRACT_LOG_TABLE(p_session_id,
 :parm_id,
 szExtrLoc,
 p_file,
 szStatus);
 :system.message_level := 10;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;

 If szStatus != 'OK' then
 message(szStatus);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 else
 -------------------------------------------------------
 ---printing the extract log report -----
 -------------------------------------------------------
 REPORT_GENERATE(p_session_id, :parm_id);
 end if;
END;

PROCEDURE REPORT_GENERATE (pl_session_id in varchar2,pl_parm_id in varchar2) IS
/* Modified on 05/15/2012; IM:8622; Mulitple Reports Server feature added */
 parameters VARCHAR2(150) := NULL;
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
 temp_return number;
 filename varchar2(1000);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dest_parm'; 
 rep_dir varchar2(30);
 temp varchar2(40);
 a_port varchar2(40);
 --val varchar2(2000);
 repid REPORT_OBJECT;
 v_rep VARCHAR2(100);
 rep_status VARCHAR2(20);
 
 --for Apps server 
 report_id Report_Object;
 ReportServerJob VARCHAR2(100);
 vc_rep_status VARCHAR2(100);
 vjob_id VARCHAR2(100);
 --url_val VARCHAR2(100);
 
 --Added on 05/15/2012; IM:8622; Multiple report server changes;
 l_svr_url VARCHAR2(100);
 l_err_msg VARCHAR2(500);
 v_err_msg VARCHAR2(500); 
 l_svr_name VARCHAR2(100);

BEGIN 
 BEGIN 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id) ;
 end if ;

 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF; 
 END; 
 --message('number -1');

-- Commented on 05/15/2012; -- IM 8622
/* Get the report server name from the master code table*/
/*
 BEGIN
 Select code_desc into val 
 from master_codes 
 where code_type='OASVR' 
 and code='RPSVR'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1); 
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 message('Report server is not defined in the SYSPARM table for REPSVR');

*/

-- Commented on 05/15/2012; -- IM 8622
/* Get the report url name from the master code table*/
/*
 BEGIN
 Select code_desc into url_val 
 from master_codes 
 where code_type='OASVR' 
 and code='RPURL'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1); 
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 message('Report server URL is not defined in the SYSPARM table for REPSVR');
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 End; 
*/
 --message('number -2');
 
 --val:='rep_chdevsrv10_oracleas1'; 
 --filename:=:rpt_parm.report_name||'_'||'_'||user;

 -- Added on 05/15/2012 to get least active jobs report server name.
 BC_CHECK_REPSERVER.get_reports_server( out_server_name => l_svr_name,
 out_error_msg => l_err_msg
 );
 
 IF l_err_msg IS NOT NULL THEN
 message('Err ' || l_err_msg);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 IF l_svr_name IS NULL THEN
 message('Error retrieving Server Name');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ------------
 
 filename:='rgrexlog'||'_'||:rpt_parm.parm_id||'_'||LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid||'.pdf';
 report_id:= find_report_object('LTREPORTS');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_FILENAME,lower('rgrexlog')); --'vdrinter.rdf');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_COMM_MODE,ASYNCHRONOUS);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_EXECUTION_MODE,BATCH);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESTYPE,file);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESNAME,filename);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESFORMAT,'pdf');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_SERVER,l_svr_name);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_OTHER, 'paramform=no');

--message('number -2');

 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_SESSION_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,pl_session_id) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_PARM_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,pl_parm_id) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'NO_OF_COPIES',TEXT_PARAMETER,'1');
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_CHAPTER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:global.chapter_id);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'PRINT_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,NULL);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'HEADER_YN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'N');
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_USER',TEXT_PARAMETER,:banner.user_id); -- for IM 7608
 --add_parameter(pl_id,'DELETE_AFTER_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,:rpt_parm.delete_after_print_flag);
 --add_parameter(pl_id,'AUTO_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,:rpt_parm.auto_print_flag);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'RPT_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,upper('rgrexlog'));
 
 ReportServerJob:=run_report_object(report_id,pl_id);
 vjob_id := substr(reportserverjob,length(l_svr_name)+2);
 vc_rep_status := REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
 
 --message('Status='||vc_rep_status);
 
 WHILE vc_rep_status in ('RUNNING','OPENING_REPORT','ENQUEUED', null)
 LOOP
 vc_rep_status:=REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
 END LOOP;
 
 --message('number -3');
 
 IF vc_rep_status='FINISHED' THEN
 --update rpt_parm set report_status = 'C'
 -- where user_name = decode(substr(user,1,3),'OPS',substr(user,5),user)
 -- and lower(report_name) = lower('oerorslp')
 -- and parm_id=:orders.order_no;
 
 --WEB.SHOW_DOCUMENT('/reports/rwservlet/getjobid'|| vjob_id ||'?server='||val,'_blank'); -- Commented below line on 11/09/2011; Ashok; Absolute path used for reports due to port change in 11g
 -- Added on 05/15/2012; Ashok; IM:8622
 IF l_svr_name IS NULL THEN
 message('Report Server name not found');pause;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 BC_CHECK_REPSERVER.get_reports_url( in_server_name => l_svr_name,
 out_server_url => l_svr_url,
 out_error_msg => v_err_msg
 );
 
 IF v_err_msg IS NOT NULL THEN
 message('Err ' || v_err_msg);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF; 
 
 --WEB.SHOW_DOCUMENT(url_val || '/reports/rwservlet/getjobid'||vjob_id||'?server='||val,'_blank'); 
 WEB.SHOW_DOCUMENT(l_svr_url || '/reports/rwservlet/getjobid'||vjob_id ||'?server='||l_svr_name,'_blank'); 
 ELSE
 message ('Report failed with error message '|| vc_rep_status);
 END IF;

 delete from rgt_extract_log where session_id=pl_session_id;
 
 :system.message_level:=10;
 commit; 
 :system.message_level:=0;
END;

declare
 /* 08/04/2018 
 Manually update this trigger (do not re-inherit) 
 BANNER is subclassed from UTILIB.fmb and SBC_BANNER trigger is similar to SRVLIB.
 */
 temp_warehouse varchar2(1);
 PROCEDURE SHOW_HINT Is
 new_item_msg varchar2(80);
 f_block varchar2(30) := GET_FORM_PROPERTY(name_in('system.current_form'),FIRST_NAVIGATION_BLOCK);
 f_item varchar2(80);
 begin
 f_item := f_block || '.' || get_block_property(f_block,FIRST_ITEM);
 loop
 exit when get_item_property(f_item,NAVIGABLE) = 'TRUE' ;
 f_item := f_block || '.' || get_item_property(f_item,NEXTITEM);
 end loop;
 default_value('TRUE','global.show_hint');
 If get_item_property(f_item,AUTO_HINT) = 'TRUE' and :global.show_hint = 'TRUE' then
 :global.show_hint := 'FALSE';
 new_item_msg := get_item_property(f_item,HINT_TEXT);
 message(substr(new_item_msg,1,80),no_acknowledge);
 end if;
 END; 
begin

 default_value(null,'GLOBAL.warehouse');

 begin
 select codabar_unit_scheme

 --

 from vserv_users

 InitForm;
 begin
 execute_trigger('util_banner');
 check_package_failure;
 --
 -- check for application ID
 --
 default_value ('NULL','global.appl_id');
 if :global.appl_id = 'NULL' then
 message ('Err: Application System not selected.');
 pause;
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;
 :ctrl_block_1.appl_id := :global.appl_id;
 --
 :ctrl_block_1.chapter_id := :global.chapter_id; -- IM 709
 -- check for rpt_user_id
 --
 default_value ('NULL','global.rpt_user_id');
 if :global.rpt_user_id = 'NULL' then
 :ctrl_block_1.rpt_user_id := :banner.user_id;
 else
 :ctrl_block_1.rpt_user_id := upper(:global.rpt_user_id) || '%';
 end if;
 erase ('global.rpt_user_id');
 --
 -- get user's default printer ID
 --
 :ctrl_block_1.user_printer_id := get_users_printer;
 --
 -- Start of changes made by Kishore on 05/08/09
 begin
 select grp_id
 into :ctrl_block_1.grp_id
 from fcn_grp_priv
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id and
 user_id = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid ;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 --
 
 --message('Super='||:global.super);pause;
 if :global.super = 'Y' then
 
 /*
 t_where_clause := 'where submit_date is not null ';
 t_where_clause := t_where_clause || 'and chapter_id = ''' || :ctrl_block_1.chapter_id || ''''; -- IM 709
 t_where_clause := t_where_clause || 'and user_name in ';
 t_where_clause := t_where_clause || '( select user_id ';
 t_where_clause := t_where_clause || 'from fcn_grp_priv ';
 t_where_clause := t_where_clause || 'where appl_id = ''' || :ctrl_block_1.appl_id || '''';
 t_where_clause := t_where_clause || ' and grp_id = ''' || :ctrl_block_1.grp_id || ''')';
 */

 t_where_clause := t_where_clause || 'and chapter_id = ''' || :ctrl_block_1.chapter_id || ''''; 
 
 
 elsif :global.super = 'N' then
 t_where_clause := 'where user_name like ''' || :ctrl_block_1.rpt_user_id || '%''';

 t_where_clause := t_where_clause || ' and submit_date is not null'; 
 end if;
 
 set_block_property('RPT_PARM', DEFAULT_WHERE, t_where_clause);
 -- End of changes made by Kishore

 :system.message_level := '10';
 go_block('rpt_parm');
 execute_query;
 if :system.block_status = 'NEW'
 then
 message ('Msg: No reports currently available for printing');
 end if;
 :system.message_level := '0';
 end;
 
 
 -- creat timer.
 DECLARE
 refresh_timer_id timer;
 ld_milli_secs NUMBER;
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 lv_secs VARCHAR2(100);
 BEGIN
 
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF; 
 
 BEGIN
 lv_secs := '0';
 
 SELECT parameter_value INTO lv_secs
 FROM valid_parameters
 WHERE parameter_code = 'PRINTTIMER'
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, chp_sysdate + 10)
 AND ROWNUM = 1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 lv_secs := '0';
 END;
 
 IF NVL(lv_secs, '0') <> '0' THEN
 ld_milli_secs := TO_NUMBER(lv_secs) * 1000;
 
 refresh_timer_id := FIND_TIMER('PRINT_REFRESH_TIMER');
 IF ID_NULL(refresh_timer_id) THEN
 refresh_timer_id := CREATE_TIMER('PRINT_REFRESH_TIMER', ld_milli_secs, REPEAT);
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-TIMER-EXPIRED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 lv_cursor_record VARCHAR2(20);
 lv_parm_id VARCHAR2(50);
BEGIN 
 if UPPER(Get_Application_Property( TIMER_NAME )) = 'PRINT_REFRESH_TIMER' then
 
 lv_cursor_record := :SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD;
 lv_parm_id := :RPT_PARM.PARM_ID;
 
 GO_BLOCK('RPT_PARM');
 
 :system.message_level := '5';
 execute_query;
 if :system.block_status = 'NEW'
 then
 message ('Msg: No reports currently available for printing');
 end if;
 :system.message_level := '0';
 
 GO_RECORD(lv_cursor_record);
 
 IF lv_parm_id <> :RPT_PARM.PARM_ID THEN
 LOOP 
 EXIT WHEN :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE' OR lv_parm_id = :RPT_PARM.PARM_ID;
 DOWN;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 
 end if;
END;
